description: A BTCUSDT limit buy of 0.4 at 95900.1 filled in parts: the resting order, one fill of 0.1 and its `PartiallyFilled` push, one push bundling three fills of 0.1, and the `Filled` push (derived frames; four executions, five frames). An execution is delivered before the order push it causes, as the plan's E29-TC-750 reads it: no recording shows the venue's order, and K01's partial-fill run settles it.

frames.jsonl.derivation: Order rows: the transcribed option order push with these values changed and no key added or dropped: symbol and category (BTCUSDT, linear), order and link ids, side, order type, time in force, price, quantity, status, executed quantity, value and fee, remaining quantity and value, average price, created and updated times, and the push id and creation time. Execution pushes: the transcribed linear execution push with these values changed and no key added or dropped: order and link ids, execution id, side, order type, quantity, price, value, fee, order price and quantity, remaining quantity, closed size and execution PnL (an opening fill: zero), times and sequence, and the push id and creation time. Order ids are UUID-shaped fabrications; link ids are of the `OUR_ID` form (24 section 8.3) for trade group 0f8e2b6c-3d4a-4b5c-9e7f-1a2b3c4d5e6f and account a1000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001, the fixture ids of `tests/unit/oms/stream_world.py`; times count from 1746270400000 ms. Frame 3 holds three rows, as the transcribed push's `data` array allows.

expected: Each partial fill is one `executions` frame and one `orders` frame, never coalesced: `partially_filled` with `filled_qty` below `qty`, then `filled` at the last fill, the average price the quantity-weighted mean of the fills; a bundled push of three fills is split into three executions, each keyed by its own `exec_id` (E29-T05, "Bundled fills are split"; the R3 fixture class "partial fills").
